description: Every e2e test that reads a PDF with `pdf-parse` reads a valid PDF on the first attempt, on every run, locally and in CI. The tests keep checking the same product behaviour, and no assertion is weakened.

userStories.title: A valid PDF parses on the first try in every e2e test
userStories.description: As the owner, I want every e2e PDF check to read the PDF it was given, so that a red run means a real defect and no story is blocked by a test that fails on a correct file.
acceptanceCriteria: Every `pdf-parse` call in `e2e/` receives a plain `Uint8Array` (its constructor is `Uint8Array`, not `Buffer`), through one shared helper in `e2e/fixtures/pdf.ts`. A search for `pdfParse(` in `e2e/` lists no call that passes a Buffer.

*(Amendment 1)* With this story's change applied on top of `ce945fe` (the Swiss branch at US-003, where the failure reproduces), `pnpm test:e2e cover-letter-template-language --repeat-each=30` passes: 0 failed out of every test the spec runs, 30 times each. The same run without the change is recorded first and shows the failure.
*(Amendment 1)* On this story's branch (`origin/main` plus the change), the same `--repeat-each=30` run also passes with 0 failed.

The other specs that read PDFs with `pdf-parse` pass alone with `--repeat-each=5`: `cover-letter-pdf-export`, `cover-letter-swiss-pdf`, `resume-pdf-download-button`, `modern-long-sidebar-print`, `pdf-font-substitutes`, `resume-page-break-pdf-count`, `resume-preview-page-breaks`.
No assertion, expected value, timeout or test is changed, skipped or removed. The diff touches only how bytes are handed to `pdf-parse`, plus the comments explaining why.
`pnpm test:parity` keeps its baseline: MATCH 211, KNOWN 3, NEW 0, or the counts on `origin/main` when the story runs, recorded before and after.
FR-1: One helper in `e2e/fixtures/pdf.ts` turns PDF bytes into the value every `pdf-parse` call receives: a plain `Uint8Array` with its own ArrayBuffer, holding exactly the PDF's bytes.
FR-2: The PDF bytes the tests download or print are not changed or re-encoded. Only the type pdf-parse receives changes.
FR-3: No new dependency (`CLAUDE.md` §9).
Regression constraint: Every spec that reads a PDF reads the same text, page sizes, positions and image counts as before.
Regression constraint: `rasteriseColumns` and the parity report keep their output. The parity report's counts are unchanged.
Regression constraint: No file under `src/` changes.
Verification: The `CLAUDE.md` §14 baseline on the final diff: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, `pnpm test:e2e`, `pnpm build`, and `pnpm lint` against the tracked ceiling.
Verification: `pnpm test:parity`, compared with the count before the change.

Verification: *(Amendment 1)* `pnpm test:e2e cover-letter-template-language --repeat-each=30` on `ce945fe`, first without the change (showing the failure), then with it (0 failures). The change is applied on a local scratch branch that is never pushed. Also run once on this story's branch, with 0 failures.
Verification: `--repeat-each=5` for each of the other specs named in US-001.
Verification: `code-reviewer` on the story.
FAIL condition: Any `pdf-parse` call in `e2e/` still receives a Node Buffer.
FAIL condition: The repeat run of `cover-letter-template-language` has any failure.
FAIL condition: An assertion, expected value, timeout or test is changed, skipped or removed.
FAIL condition: A file under `src/` changes, or a dependency is added.
FAIL condition: The parity counts change.
BLOCKER condition: *(Amendment 1)* The failure does not reproduce on `ce945fe` without the change, so the before/after comparison cannot be made. Report it; do not claim a fix.
BLOCKER condition: A plain `Uint8Array` changes what pdf-parse reads (text, page sizes, positions) for any spec. Report it with the difference; the owner decides.
Out of scope: Product code: routes, PDF rendering, the Word builder, templates. Nothing under `src/` changes.
Out of scope: Upgrading or replacing `pdf-parse` or its bundled pdf.js, or adding a dependency.
Out of scope: Changing `Buffer.poolSize` or any Playwright or Node configuration.
Out of scope: Retrying a failed parse, warming pdf.js up, or catching `bad XRef entry`.

Out of scope: The mixed pdf.js versions (recorded under Risks). Three call sites pass no `version`, and pdf-parse keeps whichever pdf.js build loads first in a process. Pinning them is a separate decision.
Out of scope: Any other flaky test.
Out of scope: The `cover-letter-swiss-format` stories; US-004 is committed after this merges.
